t: The Fluid Injector allows you to insert the fluids needed to reprocess waste materials into the Reprocessor.$(br2) Different waste types may require different fluids.
流体注入器允许你向再处理器中注入再处理废料所需的流体。$(br2)不同类型的废料可能需要不同的流体。
$(l)Mandatory:$() one, and only one, is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any vertical face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
$(l)必需：$()需要且只能有一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意垂直面上（不在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()否
